subject: Biotechnology
title: The First Gene Therapy Trial
description: One-minute skill: The First Gene Therapy Trial.

hook.text: In 1990, a four-year-old girl received the first approved gene therapy — for a deadly immune deficiency.

buildup.text: Ashanti DeSilva had ADA-SCID — her immune cells could not fight infections because one gene was broken.

discovery.text: Doctors extracted her white blood cells, inserted a working ADA gene, and returned them — her immunity improved.

twist.text: The effect was temporary — the corrected cells died off and she still needed enzyme replacement therapy.

climax.text: The trial proved gene therapy was possible — but permanent cures would need better vectors and techniques.

punchline.text: The first gene therapy patient is still alive — proof of concept earned.

quiz.question: Why was the first gene therapy only temporarily effective?
options: The patient's immune system destroyed the therapeutic gene
The corrected cells eventually died off without permanent genomic integration
The inserted gene mutated and stopped functioning
